ns2:course.label: Analysis of Nonlinear Systems
ns2:course.description: First-level graduate course on the analysis on nonlinear dynamical systems, covering topics such as nonlinear dynamics, vector fields and flows, Lyapunov stability theory, regular and singular perturbations, averaging, integral manifolds, input-output and input-to-state stability, and various design applications in control systems and robotics. Same as GE 520, and ME 546. Prerequisite: ECE 515 and MATH 385.
